messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — FinTech prospect wants an EU-only POC. Key asks: BYO-KMS, list of EU subprocessors, and strict routing to eu-west region. Also asking if we can guarantee no cross-border control-plane telemetry. Any immediate blockers?
liam_se: Do we know expected qps / token volume? batching/latency tradeoffs will affect whether hosted can meet their SLA.
emma_sales: Customer expects ~200qps peak, mostly short chat sessions (avg 60 tokens/request). They want <200ms tail latency if possible.
noah_security: Quick notes: BYO-KMS for customer keys is doable but needs HSM-backed KMS + attestation. We need to confirm which CSPs support HSM in their EU regions and whether subprocessors list includes them. Also they requested subprocessor SOC2 + DPIA evidence.
olivia_ops: Tagging runbook: redwood-bot: /link runbook-eu-residency-setup (internal) :link: — includes steps for tenant pinning + control-plane isolation.
redwood-bot: Deploy checklist created: ENG-RESIDENCY-431. Ops runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/eu-residency-setup.
maria_ae: Pricing question from the buyer: what is the delta for reserved/dedicated capacity vs hosted with routing pin? They're sensitive to cost but need guarantee. Can eng give a ballpark?
liam_se: Ballpark: reserved dedicated pool to hit 200qps with <200ms tail probably needs 2x small GPUs depending on model and quantization — delta ~ 40-60% above hosted list price for that capacity if we reserve. But I'll confirm with infra. Also can we offer an SLO-based credit if we pin to EU?
noah_security: Also flag: they asked for "no cross-border control-plane telemetry." We need legal sign-off — full control-plane isolation requires Private deployment or dedicated control-plane routing; hosted control plane still may send anonymized telemetry to non-EU. I can prep a response for legal.
emma_sales: Ok. Action items: 1) liam to confirm resource sizing and whether model quantization + batching meets latency at 200qps. 2) olivia to confirm subprocessors list + BYO-KMS HSM availability in eu-west. 3) noah to draft legal/security note about control-plane options. 4) maria to hold price expectation thread with customer.
liam_se: I'll run a quick perf sim this afternoon. If you want to be conservative, plan for 2x A10-size instances for dedicated, or 1x A100 + burst. Will share numbers.
olivia_ops: Current EU subprocessors: AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (europe-west1), Azure (northeurope) — will export attestation docs. BYO-KMS: available on Dedicated and Private; hosted BYO paths require partner attestation.
noah_security: Drafting reply: "For hosted customers we offer region pinning for data paths and a subprocessors list; BYO-KMS and complete control-plane isolation require Dedicated or Private deployment. We can provide SOC2 + DPIA artifacts and review telemetry configs." Will post draft for review.
maria_ae: Customer also wants an example routing policy config to show network/ops team. Can someone drop a quick sample?
liam_se: Example routing snippet (for presales doc):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant_pin: eu-west-1
  prefer_subnet: eu-private
  fallthrough: dedicated-eu
  allow_control_plane_outside_region: false
```
liam_se: Note: "allow_control_plane_outside_region: false" only applies if control plane is configured for isolation (Dedicated/Private).
emma_sales: Perfect. If we can get the perf sim + subprocessors export + noah's legal blurb by EOD tomorrow, I'll schedule a joint call with customer and share price delta. :thumbsup:
noah_security: Will post draft here by 16:00 UTC.
olivia_ops: I'll attach subprocessors export to the ENG-RESIDENCY-431 ticket when ready.
maria_ae: I'll prep the customer-facing one-pager with two pricing options: Hosted (with caveat) and Dedicated (BYO-KMS + control-plane isolation) and include the routing snippet.
liam_se: Perf sim queued, will share results + recommended instance mix in ENG-RESIDENCY-431.
emma_sales: Thanks team — keeping this tight. If legal needs anything else, ping me and I'll escalate. :pray:
